title: Modeling Depth Ambiguity: A Mixture-Density Representation for Flying-Point-Free Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2606.02552v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite advances in depth estimation, flying points remain a persistent failure mode: near object boundaries, depth estimators often predict spurious 3D points in the empty space between foreground and background surfaces. We trace this artifact to a standard modeling choice: assigning each pixel a single depth hypothesis. At boundaries, a pixel can straddle a foreground and a background surface, so its true depth is ambiguous between the two. A model that predicts a single depth cannot keep both possibilities, so training instead pulls the prediction toward an intermediate depth that lies on neither surface. We address this with MDA, a mixture-density representation that lets the model predict multiple depth hypotheses and their associated probabilities for each pixel. translated_title: 建模深度歧义：一种用于无飞行点深度估计的混合密度表示
translated_abstract: 尽管深度估计技术不断进步，飞行点仍是一种持续存在的失效模式：在物体边界附近，深度估计器常常在前景与背景表面之间的空白区域预测出虚假的三维点。我们将这一伪影归因于一种标准的建模选择：为每个像素仅分配单一的深度假设。在边界处，一个像素可能同时跨越前景和背景表面，因此其真实深度在两者之间存在歧义。预测单一深度的模型无法同时保留这两种可能性，因此训练过程会将预测拉向一个既不属于前景也不属于背景表面的中间深度。我们提出了MDA——一种混合密度表示，使模型能够为每个像素预测多个深度假设及其对应的概率。在边界附近，不同的假设可以分别与不同的表面对齐，最终解码出的深度从这些假设中选取，而不是被放置在两个表面之间的空白区域。
tldr: 提出混合密度表示MDA，让模型为每个像素预测多个深度假设及其概率，从而从根本上消除深度估计中物体边界处的“飞行点”伪影。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MDA, a mixture-density representation that predicts multiple depth hypotheses with associated probabilities per pixel, fundamentally eliminating "flying point" artifacts at object boundaries caused by single-depth modeling.
